note: Hand-set coefficients, NOT fit on shadow data. This is a placeholder that lets the system produce a plausible, monotonic trust score from day one. It MUST be replaced by evals/calibration/fit_trust_score.py's output (spec §7.1) after 500+ shadow-mode (signals, correct/incorrect) pairs have been collected — see spec §14 P2 exit condition. Weights are deliberately NOT dominated by quote_source_in_topk/negation_consistent/quote_match_ratio alone: those are already separately hard-gated as booleans in router.py before trust is ever computed, so letting them alone push trust above t_auto would make the trust threshold check practically dead code for the auto-reply branch. Retrieval quality (rerank_top1/margin) carries the largest weight on purpose. 2026-10-04: category_consistent (weight 0.6) removed; it was 1.0 for every proposal that reached the trust score, so its weight moved into the intercept (-4.0 to -3.4): every routing decision and every stored trust score is unchanged (trust is only computed for a run with a proposal, where it was always 1.0). 2026-10-11: bm25_keyword_hit (weight 0.5) removed with BM25 on the ticket (ADR-0020). Unlike category_consistent it varied per ticket, so trust falls by up to the weight's share for tickets where BM25 agreed with Jev; the intercept is unchanged and the version is bumped, since stored scores no longer recompute from this file.
